top_signals.title: Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes
top_signals.summary: Housing data deteriorated further in September, according to separate reports Tuesday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Top Chicken Supplier Brazil Acts to Ease Hit From Virus Outbreak
top_signals.summary: Brazil raced to contain the trade fallout from an outbreak of a highly contagious bird disease as poultry shipments to countries including top buyer China faced restrictions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
